x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: The lab's jobs. The workflow to run is the one the working directory's components declare.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show every log entry in its highest detail. [default: False]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Show each step's outcome, but only failure detail. [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Rehearse the job without pushing, tagging, releasing, or commenting. [default: False]

options.name: --auto-approve
options.description: Approve a job up front, for runs with nobody there to confirm. [default: False]

commands.name: cd
commands.description: Opens a shell in the lab's root on this node, or where its tools are installed.

arguments.name: PLACE
arguments.description: root, the default, or tools. [default: Root]

commands.name: exec
commands.description: Runs a pinned tool with the environment its env files resolve to.

options.name: --env
options.description: An env file the tool runs under, its references read; given again for another, a later file's variable over an earlier one's.

arguments.name: TOOL
arguments.description: The tool, at the version .config/lab-tools.json pins when it pins one.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Makes this machine the lab's: chezmoi, and on a node its system and its runners.

options.name: --node
options.description: The node this machine is, when its hostname does not say.

options.name: --repository
options.description: The repository to clone, when it is not Forgejo's: the GitHub mirror, in a cold start.

commands.name: teardown
commands.description: Takes down what the lab deployed on this node, keeping its state.

commands.name: deploy
commands.description: Builds the component's images, installs it on the node and converges its stack.

commands.name: backup
commands.description: Snapshots the state into the restic repository, stopping the stack for the duration when one is named.

commands.name: snapshots
commands.description: Lists the service's snapshots, newest first.

options.name: --offsite
options.description: Read the offsite repository rather than the local one. [default: False]

commands.name: restore
commands.description: Stops the stack, sets its state aside, restores a snapshot in its place and starts it again.

options.name: --snapshot
options.description: The snapshot to restore, by id. The latest when left out.

options.name: --any-image
options.description: Restore onto whatever image the stack runs, rather than the one the snapshot was taken under. [default: False]

options.name: --offsite
options.description: Restore from the offsite repository rather than the local one. [default: False]

commands.name: restore-drill
commands.description: Restores what proves the latest snapshot into a scratch directory and asserts it came back, from the offsite repository with --offsite.

options.name: --offsite
options.description: Read the offsite repository rather than the local one. [default: False]

commands.name: sync
commands.description: Pulls the vault from Obsidian Sync, commits what changed and pushes it to Forgejo.

commands.name: rotate
commands.description: Rotates the logs the component's agent writes on this node.

commands.name: offsite
commands.description: Copies new snapshots to the offsite repository, applies retention to both, and pings the dead man's switch.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Checks both repositories' integrity, reading a sample of the offsite copy's data back.

commands.name: ping
commands.description: Pings the lab's healthchecks.io check: proof the scheduler is alive.

commands.name: renew
commands.description: Issues or renews the wildcard certificate with lego and reloads caddy.

commands.name: register
commands.description: Registers a node's Actions runner with Forgejo, from the secret the vault holds for it.

options.name: --node
options.description: The node whose runner to register, by its name: mini, studio, pi.

options.name: --kind
options.description: Which runner: host (the default) or docker.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Checks every component declared here or within, the whole lab at the root.

options.name: --changed
options.description: Checks every component the checkout changes, from wherever it runs: since the pull request's base, or origin's default branch, and what isn't committed yet. [default: False]
